prompts.endgame-ship-research:
Look first: game_state research_current and research_ship*.
Order: ShipBasics, ShipCryptosleep, ShipReactor, ShipEngine, ShipComputerCore, ShipSensorCluster.
No research tool: game_open_main_tab Research, game_take_screenshot, game_drag_cell to pan, game_click_ui_target the project, game_close_main_tab.

Done: research_shipreactor true and the rest queued.

reply_owner: ask him to queue the ship research by hand.
ladder_set mark research_click_refused false.
Keep working other rungs meanwhile.

Look first: steel, plasteel, uranium, adv_components, components, gold vs SHIP_*.
empire_pass; add_bill for components; Mining priority 1 on plasteel/uranium/gold veins.
Trade the rest: best Social pawn on the comms console, call a trader to land from the drop down, select it on the comms again.

Look first: count_aipersonacore.
Sources: quest rewards (game_list_letters), exotic trader via the comms console, ancient shrine casket (arm everyone first).
Refused trade: wait for the next trader; never sell irreplaceable tech.
Done: count_aipersonacore >= 1.

say: ask chat to watch for exotic traders. reply_owner once.
Keep building everything else.

empire_pass for arms and stock; turrets and mortars on the kill box via game_apply_architect_designator; meal bills.

Beams, caskets (one per colonist), computer core, sensor cluster, 3 engines, reactor last.
play_slices 6 between; game_state ship_parts.

Done: ladder_set mark ship_built true.

Screenshot, game_get_cell_info the cell, ladder_set mark ship_site_set false, reply_owner, ladder_set mark ship_place_refused false.
prompts.endgame-reactor-start:

Click the reactor, game_list_selected_gizmos, game_execute_gizmo the start label.

say: the countdown is on, raids are coming.

empire_pass every turn. Hostiles: draft behind the turrets; grenadiers, snipers, rockets first.

Never leave the kill box.

order_pawn each colonist onto a casket, option 'Enter'; handlers carry animals.
game_list_colonists: nobody outside.

say a clean farewell; webcam launch mood.
